evidence.quote: Relapsed or refractory ALL subjects with B cell phenotype who have received at least two prior therapeutic regimens

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Have relapsed or been refractory after at least one standard chemotherapy regimen and at least one salvage treatment.
Be ineligible for allogeneic stem cell transplant (SCT), have refused SCT, or have recurred after SCT; and
Be unable to access (in a timely manner), ineligible for, or have relapsed/failed after or not responded to a commercially available CD19 CAR T-cell construct
Cannot have evidence of active graft-versus-host disease (GVHD) requiring systemic immunosuppression

labels.note: Age 31 within 3-39; relapsed after SCT, CD19/CD22+; depends on access to commercial CD19 CAR-T.
